クリスマスパーティーまでもうすぐ。今日は屋上でクララの歌の練習を\n手伝った。と:
The Christmas party is almost here. Today, I help Kurara practice her singing
on the rooftop. All I have to do is give my impressions, though.
みんなが休憩から戻ったら、練習再開ね。: Once everyone gets back from their break, we'll start again.
そうだな。のどの調子は大丈夫か？: Right. How's your throat holding up?
どんなケアをしてるんだ？: How do you take care of it?
ええ、問題ないわ。\nちゃんと毎日ケアしてるし、まだまだ調子いいわね。:
It's fine.
I look after it every day, and it's still in good shape.
そうね……まずは乾燥対策ね。こまめな水分補給に、部屋の加湿とか。\nあとは喉周り:
Well... First, I keep it from getting dry. I drink regularly and keep my room humid.
I keep my throat warm, too... And I look after my health in general.
さすがだな……: You really are on top of things...
本番でのどガラガラとか笑えないもの。: Turning up hoarse for the performance would be no joke.
やると決めたらとことん全力なところは、クララの魅力だな。: Once you decide to do something, you give it everything you've got. I like that about you.
と、当然のことをしてるだけよ……！\nサンタクイーンになるために、妥協なんてして:
I-I'm just doing what I should...!
If I'm going to be Santa Queen, I can't cut corners.
ずっと歌いっぱなしだったし、もう少し休憩しよう。\n何か温かい飲み物でも買ってこ:
You've been singing nonstop. Let's take a longer break.
Want me to get you something warm to drink?
さっき温かいお茶買ってきたばかりよ。\nあと泉花が戻って来るのを待つだけでも十分:
I just bought some hot tea.
Waiting for Senka to get back will give me plenty of time to rest.
気を使いすぎじゃない？: Aren't you fussing over me a bit too much?
そりゃそうだろ。本番で全力のクララの歌声を聞きたいしな。\nもし練習のせいでのど:
Of course I am. I want to hear you at your best when you perform.
If you ruin your voice practicing, that defeats the whole point.
…………わかったわ。もう少し休む。: ...All right. I'll rest a little longer.
